"""Temporal candidate controller with safety gating and bounded progress memory."""

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
MOTION_ACTIONS = ("FORWARD", "VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT")


def safety_contract(observation, memory):
    """Stop when confidence is low or forward motion carries substantial risk."""
    if observation["safety_confidence"] < 0.60 or observation["closing_risk"] >= 0.75:
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        return "STOP", 0.99
    return None


def tracking_contract(observation, memory):
    """Verify target persistence, then reacquire with a stable bounded scan."""
    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    reliable = (
        visible
        and observation["target_confidence"] >= 0.55
        and observation["target_identity_confidence"] >= 0.60
    )
    if not reliable:
        lost = int(observation["lost_steps"])
        if memory.get("state") in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "REACQUIRE"} and lost <= 1:
            memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
            return "STOP", 0.92
        direction = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
        memory["scan_direction"] = (
            "SCAN_RIGHT" if direction == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
        )
        memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
        return direction, 0.75
    if int(observation["track_age"]) < 2:
        memory["state"] = "VERIFY"
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80
    return None


def propose_moves(observation, memory):
    """Generate directional corrections before forward motion, respecting corridors."""
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    moves = []
    if bearing < -10.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        moves.append("VEER_LEFT")
    elif bearing > 10.0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        moves.append("VEER_RIGHT")
    if observation["corridor_center"]:
        moves.append("FORWARD")
    if observation["corridor_left"]:
        moves.append("VEER_LEFT")
    if observation["corridor_right"]:
        moves.append("VEER_RIGHT")
    return list(dict.fromkeys(moves))


def progress_contract(observation, memory, candidates):
    """Choose the least corrective safe move while suppressing temporal oscillation."""
    if not candidates:
        return None
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    previous = memory.get("last_action")
    preferred = (
        "VEER_LEFT" if bearing < -10.0 else
        "VEER_RIGHT" if bearing > 10.0 else
        "FORWARD"
    )
    if preferred in candidates and not (
        previous in {"VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"}
        and preferred != previous
        and abs(bearing) < 18.0
    ):
        return preferred
    if "FORWARD" in candidates:
        return "FORWARD"
    return candidates[0]


def termination_contract(observation, memory):
    """Return a high-confidence stationary fallback when no move is admissible."""
    memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
    return "STOP", 0.98


def decide(observation, memory):
    """Apply safety, tracking, arrival, progress, and fallback contracts in order."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})

    safety = safety_contract(observation, memory)
    if safety is not None:
        return safety[0], safety[1], memory

    tracking = tracking_contract(observation, memory)
    if tracking is not None:
        memory["last_action"] = tracking[0]
        return tracking[0], tracking[1], memory

    memory["state"] = "LOCKED"
    near = observation["target_distance_class"] == "near"
    if near:
        aligned = abs(float(observation["heading_error"])) <= 15.0
        identified = observation["target_identity_confidence"] >= 0.80
        if aligned and identified:
            memory["state"] = "ARRIVED"
            memory["last_action"] = "ARRIVED"
            return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory
        candidates = [
            "VEER_LEFT" if float(observation["target_bearing"]) < 0.0
            else "VEER_RIGHT"
        ]
    else:
        candidates = propose_moves(observation, memory)

    action = progress_contract(observation, memory, candidates)
    if action is None:
        fallback = termination_contract(observation, memory)
        memory["last_action"] = fallback[0]
        return fallback[0], fallback[1], memory

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
    memory["last_action"] = action
    memory["last_bearing"] = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    return action, 0.90, memory


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
